name: Windows — Defender / EDR / Firewall Tampering
description:
Attacker objective
Disable or blind endpoint defenses — Microsoft Defender, the EDR sensor, or the host firewall — to evade detection before further action.

Attack logic
Attackers disable real-time protection, add exclusions, remove signatures, stop the AV/EDR service, unload minifilter drivers, or turn off the host firewall.

Why this detection works
Process command-line auditing records the tamper commands (Set-MpPreference, MpCmdRun, service stop of the defender/EDR services, netsh firewall off, fltmc unload), independent of case.

False positives
An administrator legitimately reconfiguring Defender or the firewall during maintenance.

Tuning
Correlate with change control; allowlist sanctioned management automation identities; investigate unexpected actors.

Required telemetry
Process creation with command line: Sysmon Event ID 1 and Windows Security 4688.
author: raadabujaish
note:
## Investigation guide
1. Identify the host/user and the exact tamper command.
2. Verify against change control; unexplained defense-tampering is a strong pre-attack indicator — treat the host as suspect.
3. Check whether protection was re-enabled and hunt for activity in the blind window.
false_positives: An administrator legitimately reconfiguring Defender or the firewall during maintenance.
query:
FROM logs-windows.sysmon_operational-*,logs-system.security-* METADATA _id, _index, _version
| WHERE (event.code == "1" OR event.code == "4688") AND process.command_line IS NOT NULL
| EVAL cl = TO_LOWER(process.command_line)
| WHERE (cl LIKE "*set-mppreference*" AND cl LIKE "*disable*")
   OR (cl LIKE "*add-mppreference*" AND cl LIKE "*exclusion*")
   OR (cl LIKE "*set-mppreference*" AND cl LIKE "*exclusion*")
   OR (cl LIKE "*mpcmdrun*" AND cl LIKE "*removedefinitions*")
   OR (cl LIKE "*stop*" AND (cl LIKE "*windefend*" OR cl LIKE "*wdnissvc*" OR cl LIKE "*sense*" OR cl LIKE "*mssense*"))
   OR (cl LIKE "*netsh*" AND cl LIKE "*advfirewall*" AND cl LIKE "*state off*")
   OR (cl LIKE "*netsh*" AND cl LIKE "*firewall*" AND cl LIKE "*opmode*" AND cl LIKE "*disable*")
   OR (cl LIKE "*fltmc*" AND cl LIKE "*unload*")
| KEEP @timestamp, host.name, user.name, process.name, process.parent.name, process.command_line, event.code, winlog.event_data.SubjectUserName
